title: ReviewLineageBudgetV1
description: One global review budget per PR lineage (#1518). Preflight, implementation verifier, A2AD, finalizer correction, and GitHub review MUST NOT each reset independent correction counters. Exhaustion is terminal and visible. See docs/specs/bounded-pr-review-lifecycle/spec.md.

maxWallClockSeconds.description: Total lineage wall clock from freeze to terminal state. Default 6h.

maxCorrectionGenerations.description: Bounded correction generations after the original head.

maxReviewerRuns.description: Initial review run plus resolution review run.

maxReviewerReplacements.description: Classified infrastructure failure only; never resets the budget.

repeatedFindingThreshold.description: Identical unresolved finding signatures that trigger early stop.

onExhaustion.description: Terminal behavior on budget exhaustion; never auto-retry, never stay running. Intent drift transitions to intent_conflict via the drift guard, not via budget exhaustion.
